page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, with an ornamental fleuron band above the title. No margin notes. Title block centred at top, dedicatory list of names in hanging-indent paragraphs, closing italic line at foot right.

main_text.head: Nobilissimis, generosissimis Prudentissimis VIRIS
main_text.p: Dn. NICOLAO à WATTENWEIL, Baroni in Diesbach/ Domino in Jegistorff/ antiquo stemmatis splendore Nobilissimo, Generosissimo.

Dn. EMANUELI WURSTEMBERGERO, Domini Rodolphi Wurstembergeri in florentissima Reip. Bernensi Tribunatu Romanicae Provinciae Quaestoratu cum laude defuncti, Filio, omni literarum genere Exercitatissimo, Prudentissimo.
Dn. CHRISTOPHORO STEIGERO, Domini Emanuelis Steigeri ejusdem ditionis olim Quaestoris Meritissimi, nunc chorum beatorum cingentis, Filio, acumine ingenii Perspicacissimo, Literatissimo.
Dn. ALBERTO STEIGERO, Domino in Wichdorff / generis nobilitate Clarissimo Suavissimo.
Dn. NICOLAO JENNERO, Domini Nicolai Jenneri Senatoris Dignissimi, Filio Dignissimo, Humanissimo.
Dn. JACOBO FISCHERO, Domini Samuelis Fischeri in illustri Reip. Bernensi quoad ditionem Germanicam Quaestoris spectatissimi Filio, in Archivarum Registratura Laboriosissimo, Politissimo.
Dn. ANTHONIO KILCHBERGERO, Domini Anthonii Kilchbergeri Tribuni plebis Consultissimi Filio, Erlachicarum copiarum in Gallia locum tenenti strenuissimo, fortissimo.
Dn. ALBERTO BENOICT, Medicinae Doctoratu nobilitato, Laudatissimo, Doctissimo.

page.notes: Ornamental fleuron band at top is decorative and not transcribed. Scan shows a faded stain at left centre. The word "Wichdorff" is shown with a black-letter/ornamental initial W and is rendered approximately. "Wurstembergeri" and "Erlachicarum" are as printed. Names of the dedicatees are in small capitals; "Dn." abbreviations are printed in small capitals with stops.
